title: Light Painting a Pair of Red, White, and Admiral Blue Corvettes
description: A pretty light painted photograph of a pair of red, white, and Admiral Blue Corvettes. A 2019 Corvette Grand Sport is on the left, and a 1996 Corvette Grand Sport is on the right. Rick & Lois's pretty Memorial Garden served as the backdrop for this cool image.

title: Light Painting a 1967 Corvette Coupe
description: A stunning light painted photograph of Larry and Bev's “Hot” Razzleberry 1967 Corvette Resto-Mod Coupe (and their pretty home too!).

title: Light Painting the "Bumble Bee" Corvette
description: A beautiful light painted photo of a 2014 “Bumble Bee” Yellow Stingray Convertible with the top up. (Look for the "top down" version in "Light Painting Stories - 2026"). This pretty image was created right on the shores of the Lake of the Ozarks, in Osage Beach, Missouri.

title: Light Painting a '63 "Split-Window" Corvette
description: A beautiful light painted photograph of a 1963 "Split-Window" Corvette. The Aurora Borealis was out that night and made for an even cooler image!

title: Light Painting a Bentley Continental GT Speed and a Corvette E-Ray
description: We created this pretty light painted image of a 2016 Bentley Continental GT Speed along with a 2025 C8 Corvette E-Ray in Hot Springs, Arkansas.

title: Four Light Paintings of a Long Beach Red 2016 Corvette Z06
description: A stunning light painted photograph of Tom and Amanda's amazing Long Beach Red 2016 C7 Corvette Z06! Tom got permission to create their project at a beautiful mansion in Oklahoma! Both the Corvette Z06’s hood and trunk liners feature custom hand-painted artworks with blood moons. So, as per Tom’s request, I added one to the final image in post-production!

title: Four Light Paintings of a Long Beach Red 2016 Corvette Z06
description: This engine compartment light painting is so darn cool! The custom, hand-painted hood liner featuring a bald eagle and a blood moon is the icing on the cake!

title: Four Light Paintings of a Long Beach Red 2016 Corvette Z06
description: Placing a camera inside any Corvette to light paint the interior is never easy. However, the final results are certainly worth it! The interior of Tom and Amanda's Long Beach Red 2016 C7 Corvette Z06, with the custom hand-painted hood liner seen through the windshield, looks amazing!

title: Four Light Paintings of a Long Beach Red 2016 Corvette Z06
description: The custom, hand-painted trunk liner featuring a soaring bald eagle and another blood moon makes this light-painted image of the car's rear end even better! Tom and Amanda's Corvette Z06 is so very cool!

title: Light Painting a 2015 C7 Corvette Z06
description: This beautiful light painting of a 2015 C7 Corvette Z06 was created in Oklahoma. I met the owners, Chad and Shelly, at Lake of the Ozark's Corvette Club annual show back in April.

title: Light Painting a Trio of Corvettes
description: A trio of beautiful light-painted Corvettes! From left to right we have a Torch Red C5 2002 Corvette Convertible, a 2012 Carlisle Blue Corvette Grand Sport Convertible, and a Long Beach Red 2019 Corvette Stingray Coupe.

title: Light Painting Corvettes and Racehorses
description: A pretty light painted photograph of Jim's Corvettes and two racehorses in front of his beautiful home. The cars are a 1967 C2 Corvette Roadster Convertible L79 and a 2023 C8 Corvette 70th Anniversary Edition Z51. The two Quarter Horses are “Rookie” and "Boujee". Rookie is a 12-year-old and Rookie is eight. Both horses are trained in women’s barrel racing! Ridden by Jim's daughter Madison, both horses have placed in the Amateur Pro Association (APA) barrel horse races!

title: Light Painting a Corvette in a Cave!
description: Really cool light painting of Darin & Krista's "Batmobile", a pretty Watkins Glen Grey 2019 Corvette Grand Sport. We created this unusual light painting project in a cave in southern Missouri.

title: A 14-Vehicle Light Painting Project (with 8 Corvettes)!
description: Included in this one-of-a-kind light painting project are a 1957 C1 Corvette, a 1960 C1 Corvette, a 1965 C2 Corvette Coupe, a 1969 C3 Corvette Coupe, a 1993 C4 Corvette Convertible ZR1, a 2013 50th Anniversary Edition C6 Corvette Convertible, a 2016 C7 Corvette Convertible Z06, a 2024 Chevrolet Z06 Corvette Coupe 3LZ, a 1933 Ford Sedan, a 1953 Chevy Truck, the shell of NASCAR #24, a 1964 Ford Galaxie 500XL, a 1959 Chevrolet El Camino, and a 1964 Chevrolet El Camino!

title: Light Painting 5 Beautiful Corvettes at a Hunting Lodge
description: A stunning one-of-a-kind light painted photograph of 5 Corvettes at a hunting lodge at sunset. Included in this photo are a 1966 Corvette Stingray Convertible, a 2004 Corvette C6 Z06 Leman’s Commemorative Edition, a 2013 Corvette 60th Anniversary ZR1, a 2019 Corvette ZR1, and a 2023 Corvette Z06!

title: Light Painting a Stunning '58 Corvette at Lake of the Ozarks, Missouri
description: A beautiful light painting of a black and silver 1958 C1 Corvette created with the cool rock formations found in and around Lake of the Ozarks, Missouri.

title: Light Painting a 70th Anniversary Corvette Z06 (and a flying saucer) at Lake of the Ozarks, Missouri
description: The beautiful light painted photograph of Mike and Sandy's amazing 70th Anniversary Corvette Z06 and the flying saucer from the Hollywood movie "Men In Black". The one-of-a-kind photo was created at a location that overlooked Lake of the Ozarks in Missouri.

title: A Beautiful Light Painting of a 70th Anniversary Corvette
description: Here's the final light painted image of the front end of a 2023 70th Anniversary Z06. This one got a bit interesting to create because we hit the dew point. It was challenging, but we pulled it off!

title: A Beautiful Light Painting of a 70th Anniversary Corvette
description: Light painted photograph of the "frunk" of a 70th Anniversary Corvette Z06.The wooden American Flag is a nice touch!

title: A Beautiful Light Painting of a 70th Anniversary Corvette
description: The completed light painting of the 2023 70th Anniversary Z06's remarkable interior. Getting a camera mounted in this space was quite a challenge, but it was worth it!

title: A Beautiful Light Painting of a 70th Anniversary Corvette
description: Another of the seven unique light paintings of this amazing automobile. This one is the cool engine compartment of the 70th Anniversary Corvette Z06.

title: A Beautiful Light Painting of a 70th Anniversary Corvette
description: A beautiful light painted photograph of a white 2023 70th Anniversary Z06. This was one of seven unique light paintings created of the car that night at Lake of the Ozarks, Missouri.

title: A Cool Light Painting of a 60th Anniversary Corvette Grand Sport with 3 Corporate Jets
description: An amazing light painted photograph of a 2013 60th Anniversary Corvette Grand Sport 3LT in a hangar with 3 corporate jets. This cool photograph was created at AVMATS in the Spirit of St. Louis Airport in Chesterfield. Missouri. This fabulous car, with C7 Z06 Wheels 19×10 / 20×12 chrome rims, was the "Best of Show" at the fabulous 2023 Lake of the Ozarks Corvette Show!

title: Light Painting a 2023 Corvette Both Inside & Out
description: A cool light painted photograph of the front end of a 2013, 60th Anniversary, Corvette Grand Sport 3LT. This beautiful car features Supersonic Blue Metallic paint with 60th Anniversary Silver Replica Stripes and Chrome Race Mesh Front Grill Inserts as well as a Silver Over Ride Headlight Assembly. The image was created in a hangar at the Spirit of St. Louis Airport in Chesterfield, Missouri.

title: Light Painting a 2023 Corvette Both Inside & Out
description: The amazing light painted photograph of the interior of a 2013, 60th Anniversary, Corvette Grand Sport 3LT. This amazing Corvette has a Titanium Grey Leather interior with a Custom D shaped and wrapped steering wheel. The Custom Air Brushed Hood-liner is also seen through the windshield.

title: Light Painting a 2023 Corvette Both Inside & Out
description: An amazing light painted photograph of the engine bay of a 2013, 60th Anniversary, Corvette Grand Sport 3LT created in a hangar at the Spirit of St. Louis Airport in Chesterfield, Missouri. Much of this beautiful LS3 6.2L / 428 lb-ft / 436 hp engine has Carbon Fiber Hydro Dipped Components, and has a Custom Air Brushed Hood-liner!

title: Light Painting a 2023 Corvette Both Inside & Out
description: The pre-light painting photograph of the rear end of a 2013, 60th Anniversary, Corvette Grand Sport 3LT. This beautiful car has ZR1 Color matched rear Spoiler and Eagle Eye Led Halo Tail Lights.

title: Light Painting a 2023 Corvette Both Inside & Out
description: A photograph of the rear end of a 2013, 60th Anniversary, Corvette Grand Sport 3LT. This beautiful car has ZR1 Color matched rear Spoiler and Eagle Eye Led Halo Tail Lights. This image was created in a hangar at the Spirit of St. Louis Airport in Chesterfield, Missouri.

title: Light Painting a pair of C1 Corvettes (a '57 and a '58) in a matching "She Shed"
description: A stunning light painted photograph a pair of C1 Corvette Convertibles, a Cascade Green '57, and a champagne '58, in a beautiful matching "She Shed".

title: Light Painted Photograph of a 2017 Corvette Grand Sport in Lake of the Ozarks, Missouri
description: A stunning light painted photograph of a 2017 Corvette Grand Sport in front of the client's beautiful contemporary home in Lake of the Ozarks, Missouri.

title: Light Painting a 2023 C8 Corvette Stingray at Seven Springs Winery in Lynn Creek, Missouri
description: A stunning light painted photograph of a Torch Red 2023 C8 Corvette Stingray, with the Z51 Package. This pretty image was created at Seven Springs Winery in Lynn Creek, Missouri.

title: Light Painting a '57 C1 Corvette with a cute Sheltie named Chaos
description: Here's a stunning light painted photograph of Chaos, a cute Sheltie, sitting on a beautiful 1957 C1 Corvette, nicknamed "Choas 2". This pretty fall-color light painting was created at the client's home.

title: Light Painting a cute Sheltie named Chaos with a 1957 C1 Corvette named Chaos II
description: Here's a stunning fall color light painting of Chaos 2, a beautiful 1957 C1 Corvette, with an adorable Sheltie, Chaos, on the hood!

title: Light Painting a 2017 Corvette
description: A beautiful light painted photograph of a 2017 Chevrolet Corvette. Photo was created shortly after sunset at a park in central Wisconsin.

title: Light Painting a Stunning 1957 C1 Corvette with the Owner
description: A really pretty light painted photograph of Jean, along with her 1957 C1 Corvette Convertible which she has given the nickname “Chaos 2”.

title: Light Painting a '64 C Corvette with the Owner's Home
description: A cool light painting of a 1964 Corvette Sting Ray as well as the clients home.

title: Light Painting a Stunning '58 C1 Corvette with a Sheltie Named Rebel
description: An awesome light painting of the front end of a red 1964 Corvette Sting Ray. This fun image was created right in the client's driveway as well!

title: Light Painting a Stunning '58 C1 Corvette with a Sheltie Named Rebel
description: A cool light painted photograph of the rear end of a 1964 Corvette Sting Ray. The image was created right in the client's driveway!

title: Light Painting a Stunning '58 C1 Corvette with a Sheltie Named Rebel
description: A beautiful light painted photograph of a 1958 C1 Corvette, named "Rebel 58", with an adorable Sheltie, named "Rebel", sitting on the truck. This pretty light painting was created in the driveway at the client's home.

title: Light Painting a Beautiful 1958 C1 Corvette and the Owner's Home
description: A beautiful light painted photograph of a 1958 C1 Corvette created in the driveway at the client's home.

title: Light Painting a 1957 C1 Corvette
description: The pre-light painting photograph of a Cascade Green 1957 Corvette Convertible in its very own matching "She Shed".

title: Light Painting a 1957 C1 Corvette
description: A beautiful light painting of a Cascade Green '57 Corvette Convertible. Photo was created in the vehicle's matching "She Shed".

title: Light Painting a 1957 C1 Corvette
description: A beautiful light painting of a Cascade Green '57 Corvette Convertible. This version of the light painting was created in post-production to feature just the car, without any of the surroundings.

title: Light Painting a 1958 C1 Corvette
description: The "before" photo, and the finished light painting of a mint condition 1957 Cascade Green C1 Corvette Convertible's interior.

title: Light Painting a 1958 C1 Corvette
description: A stunning light painting of a mint condition '58 C1 Corvette Convertible, nicknamed "The Rebel", in a custom "She Shed".

title: Light Painting a 1958 C1 Corvette
description: A super cool "Dark" light painting of a champagne colored 1958 C1 Corvette Convertible. The surroundings were intentionally left out of the image for effect.

title: Light Painting a 1977 Corvette (our very first Corvette Light Painting)
description: The "before" photo, and the finished light painting of a 1958 C1 Corvette Convertible's "Cove".

title: Light Painting a 1977 Corvette (our very first Corvette Light Painting)
description: Light painted photo of a white 1977 Corvette created at Anderson's Portrait Park in Mounds View, MN.
